comments.author: qa-7100be29
comments.content:
QA of task-808869c5 adds one input for the shared shape rule: SHA-256 object-format repositories.

Every Wave 1 revision validator caps at 40 hex:
- candidateStore.ts:41 SHA_RE /^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$/i
- checkRunStore.ts:43, a copy of the same regex
- receiptStore.ts:54 REVISION_RE /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/i
- finalizeAttempt.ts:41 REVISION_PATTERN, the same 40
- the wrappers' 40-zero ids (moe-agent.sh:2294, moe-agent.ps1:4034)

In a `git init --object-format=sha256` repository (64-hex ids), a `landed` finalize is refused on each of its 3 tries, the loop stops and the attempt stays finalizing. With a qualityGate, the unrecordable candidate is reported as a gate failure and the bytes are parked on a rescue ref.

Decide one rule when the regexes are unified: either accept 64 hex, or refuse sha256 repositories up front with a clear message. This is rare, and it is filed here rather than as its own task.
